_comment: Where a creature's level in the game does not match how dangerous it is. Keyed by race editor ID (tools/EspGen resolves them into threat.resolved.json, where the level floors it works out itself also live). atLeast: never ranked below this, whatever its level. atMost: never ranked above this by its level (a huge health pool can still add the toughness bump). Rank letters E D C B A S.

GiantRace._why: level 32 in the game (rank C), but deadlier than the mammoths they herd

MammothRace._why: level 38 (rank B): big, not that dangerous

DLC2NetchRace._why: level 36-40 (rank B): a high level, not a dangerous beast
